name: Indiana Jones and the Staff of Kings

locations.note: 1939: Indy races a Nazi expedition through a canyon to a ram's-head idol in a Sudanese temple.
In San Francisco Indy rescues the collector Archie Tan and his granddaughter from the local triad, with a brawl on top of a cable car.
Indy follows his old professor Kingston's trail into the jungle of Panama, where Kingston found the Sphere, and meets the photographer Maggie O'Malley.
Istanbul gives up the clues to where the Staff of Moses is hidden (Paris in the DS version).
Indy finds the elderly Kingston in a Nepalese village; the Nazis follow him to the Staff's resting place.

routes.name: The search for the Staff of Kings
routes.note: The console versions' order; the DS version has Paris in place of Istanbul.
